scenario_interaction.action: Low case: LC Recoveries recovery % changed from 27.7% (filed) to 39.6% (the filing's High-case %), via the stress-test slider
scenario_interaction.caveat: Illustrative only: the consolidated waterfall does not reproduce the filed class recoveries for this case (NEEDS REVIEW), so stressed figures inherit that limitation.

limitations: The filing aggregates 43 Debtor legal-entity waterfalls; the app's single consolidated priority waterfall cannot reproduce entity-level outcomes (e.g. Administrative Claims engine 99.5% vs filed 96% in the Low case). The app reports NEEDS REVIEW instead of forcing a match.

The p. 5 summary table is an embedded spreadsheet object. HW6's PDF visibility rules flagged its header (white on dark fill) and off-page coordinates, so the app sent that page's plain text and raised a layout warning; hidden-text protection for that page is therefore weaker and is flagged for review.
Several classes have claims that round to $0 million with non-zero filed %, which a $-millions table cannot reproduce exactly.
No hand-keyed answer key exists for Dean Foods, so field-level accuracy was not scored; grounding (every number printed in its cited row) is the only per-field check.
Manual baseline time was not measured, so no time-saving claim is made.
